recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Agricultural Science for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Iwena
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Agronomy of Major Cereal and Legume Crops
subtopics: Cultivation of Maize (Zea mays): Soil preparation, planting spacing, weed control, harvesting
Cultivation of Cowpea (Vigna unguiculata): Inoculation with Rhizobium, pest control, storage
Economic importance, post-harvest losses, and storage in hermetic bags
objectives: State recommended plant population per hectare for hybrid maize
Describe the life cycle and chemical control of the cowpea pod borer (Maruca)
Explain advantages of Purdue Improved Crop Storage (PICS) bags

topics.topic: Plant Pathology: Fungal, Bacterial and Viral Crop Diseases
subtopics: Fungal diseases: Maize rust, cocoa black pod (Phytophthora), groundnut leaf spot
Bacterial and viral diseases: Cassava mosaic disease (CMD), bacterial blight
Symptoms, vectors (whitefly Bemisia tabaci), economic damage, and integrated pest management (IPM)
objectives: Classify major tropical crop diseases by pathogen
Describe mode of transmission of cassava mosaic virus
Formulate an integrated disease management protocol for a cocoa plantation

subtopics: Reproductive anatomy of bull, cow, ram, and ewe
Estrous cycle, heat detection signs, ovulation, gestation periods in cattle (283 days)
Artificial Insemination (AI): Semen collection, cryopreservation in liquid nitrogen, insemination technique
objectives: Draw and label male and female reproductive tracts of ruminants
Identify 4 behavioral symptoms of estrus (heat) in dairy cows
Evaluate benefits of AI in genetic improvement of indigenous White Fulani cattle

topics.topic: Animal Nutrition: Digestibility and Pearson Square Ration Formulation
subtopics: Apparent digestibility calculation: (Nutrient consumed - Nutrient in feces) / Nutrient consumed
Metabolizable energy and total digestible nutrients (TDN)
Pearson Square method for balancing crude protein (CP) in livestock feed
objectives: Calculate percentage digestibility of crude protein from metabolism trial data
Use Pearson Square to formulate a 20% crude protein broiler finisher feed using maize (9% CP) and soybean meal (44% CP)
Explain economic consequences of feeding sub-optimal protein rations
